operation.description: Operation requested in the visible task instruction before solving it.

has_formulas.description: Whether formulas are present in the input workbook, if the workbook is available for inspection before solving.

preserve_formatting.description: Whether the visible task requires existing formatting to be preserved.

task_type.description: All household goal categories recognized in the visible request. Categories such as heat_place already include picking and placement; do not add plain pick_place for those steps. Use an empty list if no category is recognized.

has_quantifier.description: Whether the visible question or options include a quantifier such as every or exists.
